expectedFocusGaps.name: Search products
expectedFocusGaps.issue: textbox "Search products" is Tab-navigable in the AX tree but was never reached during Tab traversal
expectedFocusGaps.recommendation: Check: (1) tabindex="-1" making it unreachable, (2) CSS visibility:hidden/display:none, (3) aria-hidden="true" on an ancestor, (4) a focus trap preventing Tab from leaving a widget. If this is a repeated component, verify EVERY instance, not just the first.

expectedFocusGaps.issue: [Shared component — 3 pages] <input> at Tab position 6 is reachable by keyboard but has no accessible name — screen readers will announce the role only
expectedFocusGaps.recommendation: Add aria-label, aria-labelledby referencing a visible label, or place descriptive text inside the element.

focusManagementFindings.issue: After navigating to Home, focus fell to <body>/<html> — keyboard users lose context
focusManagementFindings.recommendation: After client-side route navigation, programmatically move focus to the page <h1>, a skip-to-main link, or the <main> element (e.g. React Router's useEffect, Angular's router.events, Vue Router's afterEach).
